Who: Billing staff

Time: [blank]

Tip: set a repeating phone calendar reminder for day 1 (Step 1) and another for day 3 (Step 2).

**B. First-time how-to for new staff**
```
Monthly expiry check: how to do it (first time)

Store assistant (day 1)
1. Open the tracker Google Sheet.
2. Go shelf by shelf, then the storeroom. Include bottom shelves and back corners.
3. For each item, read the batch number and the expiry date (not the manufacture date).
4. Mark Reason as Expired if the date has passed, or Near expiry if it is 60 days or less away.
5. Count the actual quantity and enter it in the tracker. If it differs from the sheet count, write a note and tell the owner.
6. Keep all these items together in one place, marked "Return".
7. Sign off.

Billing staff (by day 3)
1. Open [menu name in your billing software].
2. Make a purchase return for each item, matching the batch and quantity in the tracker.
3. Sign off.

Packing
Pack by supplier. Put a list of item, batch and quantity on each pack.

Common mistakes
- Reading the manufacture date instead of the expiry date
- Missing the storeroom
- Mixing batches of the same item
- Not updating the tracker

If you are unsure about any item, ask the owner.
```

**C. Tracker columns** (paste into cell A1 of a new Google Sheet)
```
Date checked	Item	Batch no.	Expiry date	Quantity	Reason	Supplier	Request sent on	Picked up on	Credit note received
```
Reason: Expired, Near expiry, Damaged or Slow. Credit note received: Yes or No. No money columns. You already have a Google Sheet, so compare these with your current columns. For formulas, color warnings and phone setup, take them to **tracker-sheet-builder**.

**Return or pickup request**
```
Hello, this is Sample Pet Supplies.
We have expired and near-expiry products to return: [item], batch [batch no.], quantity [quantity]; [item], batch [batch no.], quantity [quantity]. The purchase return was entered on [date].
Could you please let us know when your team can pick them up, and how the credit note will be shared? Thank you.
Sample Pet Supplies
```

**Polite follow-up** (send if there's no reply by [day you pick])
```
Hello, following up on our return request of [date] for expired and near-expiry products.
Could you please confirm the pickup date? We are happy to share any detail you need. Thank you.
Sample Pet Supplies
```

**If the supplier still doesn't reply:** call them yourself, note the date in the tracker, and check your supplier's terms or agreement. For a dispute, check with a qualified person.

**Fill in:** each [blank] in plain words. I left the packing role, the follow-up day and all the durations open because you didn't give them.

Whether expired or near-expiry items can be sold, discounted or thrown away is not for me to decide. Check with a qualified person and your supplier's terms.

It's a draft: you check it, share it with your team and send the messages yourself.

Monthly expiry check: how to do it (first time)

8. Sign off the step only when the whole shop is done.

Common mistakes:
- Checking the front of the shelf only. Check behind and below.
- Mixing two batches of one item in one row. Keep one row per batch.
- Reading the packing date as the expiry date.
- Leaving the quantity blank.
